chapter: French Opera house and cello teachers
title: Playing cello for Robichaux at an opera house ball
summary: He describes Robichaux's 30-piece orchestra for a Mardi Gras ball at the French Opera, how the tiers were arranged, and his family's ties to the opera.

But it was, uh, either one or two years, or three possibly, before the opera boy. And, uh, Rubichaud got an orchestra, he drew upon all the good musicians that he could. Piro and all the musicians, Gaspar, and all of them, Charlie McCurdy, Bloom, and all of them. We played on that occasion.
